name: design-style
title_zh: 67 套视觉风格任你挑，挑完直接落成 CSS
tagline_zh: 不是收藏夹吃灰的截图库，每套风格都带可复制的颜色、字体和 CSS。选完即用，代码和审美同时到位。
tagline_en: Not a screenshot gallery—every style ships with copy-paste colors, fonts, and CSS. Choose, apply, and match code.
desc_en: Recommend and apply design styles from a curated library of 67 visual aesthetics. Use when the user wants to choose a design style for their project, get style recommendations, or apply a style's CSS/colors/fonts to their code.
why_zh: 把「风格」从形容词变成可执行代码。内置 67 套精选美学，每套都拆解成具体 token。
why_en: Turns 'style' from vibe into executable tokens. 67 aesthetics, each decomposed into concrete specs, recommended and rendered as.
limit_zh: 只覆盖视觉层（颜色/字体/CSS），不含布局与组件逻辑。风格库固定 67 套，不增量更新。
limit_en: Visual layer only (colors/fonts/CSS); no layout or logic. Fixed 67 styles, no additions. Requires a code project—useless for pure Figma work.
title_en: 67 curated visual styles, pick one and get its CSS
